_comment: Engine audio bank. Add events here to tune them without code changes. Fields: bus(sfx|music|ambience|voice|ui), variants[](paths under data/sounds/, no extension; loader tries .ogg/.wav/.mp3), select(random|round_robin|first), gain, gain_var, pitch, pitch_var, max_instances, min_interval_ms, priority, spatial, rolloff(linear|inverse|none), inner, outer, preload. Any play_sfx() name not listed auto-registers with sane defaults. 'music' maps MusicState -> stem for audio_music_set_state() (crossfaded); if a state is omitted it defaults to music/<state>.
